meta.title: Industries — thirteen sectors, thirteen different problems | Metal Form
meta.description: Medical, beverage and PET, automotive, cosmetics, appliances, chemical, electrical, consumer goods, agriculture, plumbing, furniture, marine and custom projects. Tooling, engineering, production and supply, written for each sector.

headline: Thirteen sectors.
Thirteen different
definitions of expensive.
hero.lead: Each sector puts pressure on a different part of the tooling problem: repeatability, cavitation, surface finish, service life, compliance or supply risk. The engineering principles overlap; the buying priorities do not.

note: Each page uses the sector’s own components, failure modes, cost drivers and terminology. If your work falls outside these categories, choose Custom Projects.

cta.body: Most projects do not arrive neatly labelled. Send the part and we will work out which conversation this actually is.
